step1.description:
Nikhil Saraf, SolidJS Core Team member, and maintainer of SolidStart joins us to talk about what he's been doing lately. He has been busy implementing a fully featured React Server Component solution with routing, data fetching, and mutation on top of Vite, and he is going to share with us what he has learned.
